name: Sergei Claudius
original_name: セルゲイ・クラウディウス
source:
Sergei is the king of the kingdom who originally helped the people after the catastrophe with Herdeus ten years prior by establishing orphanages and training schools for the people. Now that Herdeus appears to be a threat once again, he provides aid to Might and his quest.

[From: [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/silver/silver.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
